originals.why: Natural Welsh. It is oedd + pronoun + isio with the same meaning, 'wanted'.

originals.ko: 우리는 무엇이 바뀌게 될지 알고 싶었어
originals.why: The Welsh never uses oedd ... isio as 'wanted': it has oeddan ni isio, and the oedd is in a separate clause (oedd yn mynd i newid). It does not practise this LEGO.
